ad_info.structure_source: library format G17 (Lifestyle con columna de beneficios y producto en primer plano)
ad_info.reference_style: Warm luxury lifestyle ad: a confident model in a glowing bokeh bedroom, a two-tone headline and a column of ringed line-icon benefits on the left, the product large in the lower-right foreground, and a rose-gold rounded delivery band at the bottom
ad_info.angle_used: Beneficio principal: ampliar el deseo de la cola a las piernas, de forma natural

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: warm champagne #F3D9B1 and rose gold #D9A38F in the light, the bokeh, the icon rings and the delivery band.
global_identity.visual_style: Photorealistic, bold and feminine supplement ad for Colombian women: a real-looking woman in a real scene, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo, fuchsia and plum brand accents.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Warm, confident and aspirational, with a believable everyday feel; soft rose-gold glow.
global_identity.graphic_language: Thin rose-gold rings around white line icons, thin fading divider lines, a satin rose-gold rounded band, clean high-contrast typography readable on a phone, clean uncluttered background.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold look).

creative_objective: Expand the central desire from the butt to the legs in one aspirational image: a confident woman in fitted jeans, three honest benefits and the real bottle large in the foreground, so the viewer understands in one second that this is a natural support for her curves, without surgery.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two-tone headline. 2) The woman's confident pose in fitted jeans. 3) The bottle in the lower-right foreground. 4) The three benefit rows. 5) The delivery band and the small registration seal.
art_direction.composition_style: Layered asymmetric composition: text column on the left third, the woman in the center-right middle ground, the bottle in the right foreground, the delivery band anchoring the bottom left and running up to the bottle. Headline at the top left above everything; a small registration seal in the top-right corner.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline line 1 at about 4-12% of the height, line 2 at about 14.5-22%, about 3.5-58% of the width, left-aligned. Benefit column about 3.5-34.5% of the width, rows at about 26-38%, 43-54% and 58-69% of the height, separated by thin lines at about 40.5% and 56.5%; each row has a ringed icon circle (about 11% of the canvas) on the left and its text starting at about 16% of the width. Woman from about 34% to 82% of the width, top of the head at about 15% of the height, cropped by the bottom edge at mid-thigh. Bottle about 78-98% of the width and 35-96% of the height. Delivery band about 3.5-76% of the width and 81-96.5% of the height. Registration seal: small rounded pill in the top-right corner, about 72-96% of the width and 4-10% of the height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm golden-hour window light with amber and rose-gold tones, soft bokeh of warm lights in the background, gentle glow on the woman's skin. The bottle has crisp studio highlights on a glossy surface with soft ripples at its base. Icon rings and dividers are thin rose-gold lines. The band has a satin rose-gold gradient and a soft shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas filled with a warm lifestyle photo of a clean, cozy bedroom with soft bokeh. A Colombian woman in fitted high-waisted jeans stands in the center-right, three-quarter view from behind, looking back over her shoulder with a confident smile. Top left, a 2-line bold uppercase headline (line 1 white, line 2 rose-gold to fuchsia gradient). Below it, a left column of three benefits separated by thin lines, each with a thin-ringed circle holding a white line icon and 2-3 lines of white text. Lower right, the real bottle large in the foreground. Bottom left, a wide rounded rose-gold band with a ringed house/delivery icon, a thin vertical divider and 2 lines of delivery and payment text. Top-right corner, a small pill-shaped registration seal.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full canvas, edge to edge; woman in the center-right
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the desire: feeling confident with curves in fitted jeans
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Clean, warm bedroom with a bed and sheer curtains heavily blurred into rose-gold bokeh. A Colombian woman about 25 years old, warm tan skin, long wavy black hair, wearing a black strappy top and medium-blue high-waisted fitted jeans, standing three-quarter turned away from camera and looking back over her shoulder with a confident, natural smile, one hand resting on her hip. Tasteful and natural: realistic body proportions, fully clothed, no exaggerated curves. Keep the left third darker and calm for the text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left column, about 3.5-14.5% of the width, one per benefit row
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Visual anchors that make each benefit scannable
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Thin rose-gold ring (about 11% of the canvas) with a simple white line icon: a leaf for natural, a capsule for 2 capsules a day, a crossed-out syringe for no needles. Same style and stroke for all.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Between the rows, at about 40.5% and 56.5% of the height, about 3.5-30% of the width
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Thin rose-gold lines fading toward the right.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower-right foreground, about 78-98% of the width and 35-96% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The real bottle exactly as in the attached product photo, upright, front view, large and studio-sharp, on a glossy surface with soft light ripples, slightly overlapping the woman's hip area without covering her face.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom left, about 3.5-76% of the width and 81-96.5% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Wide rounded rectangle in a satin rose-gold gradient with a thin lighter border and a soft shadow; on its left a thin-ringed circle holding a simple house-with-package line icon, then a thin vertical divider and two lines of text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-right corner, about 72-96% of the width and 4-10% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Trust: shows the sanitary registration given by the brand
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pill in dark plum #2B1226 at 85% opacity with a thin fuchsia border and a small white check-shield line icon, holding the registration text in white. Text only: no logos.

forbidden_additions: Any trust seal, guarantee or certification badge other than the single registration pill
Before/after images or a second photo of the woman
Boxes or cards behind each benefit
Logos or brand marks outside the bottle label
Bubbles, flowers, leaves or particles cluttering the scene

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium lifestyle supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Full-bleed photo of a clean, warm Colombian bedroom at golden hour, bed and sheer curtains heavily blurred into soft rose-gold and champagne bokeh. In the center-right (about 34-82% of the width, head top at about 15% of the height, cropped at mid-thigh by the bottom edge) a Colombian woman about 25 years old, warm tan skin, long wavy black hair, black strappy top and medium-blue high-waisted fitted jeans, stands three-quarter turned away from the camera and looks back over her shoulder with a confident natural smile, one hand on her hip; realistic proportions, fully clothed, tasteful, believable skin texture. The left third of the photo stays darker and calm. Top left (3.5-58% of the width), a two-line extra-bold uppercase headline: line 1 white at about 4-12% of the height, line 2 in a rose-gold to fuchsia #E6177F gradient at about 14.5-22%. Below, a left column (3.5-34.5% of the width) of three benefit rows at about 26-38%, 43-54% and 58-69% of the height, separated by thin fading rose-gold lines; each row has a thin rose-gold ring with a white line icon (leaf, capsule, crossed-out syringe) and 2-3 lines of white text. In the lower-right foreground (78-98% of the width, 35-96% of the height) the real product, large, upright and studio-sharp: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth; the black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE', the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom; it stands on a glossy surface with soft light ripples. Bottom left (3.5-76% of the width, 81-96.5% of the height) a wide rounded satin rose-gold band with a soft shadow: a thin-ringed circle with a house-with-package line icon, a thin vertical divider and two lines of deep plum text. Top-right corner (72-96% of the width, 4-10% of the height) a small rounded dark plum pill with a thin fuchsia border, a tiny white check-shield icon and white text. Clean, uncluttered, premium, everything readable on a phone. No other elements.

mandatory_visual_elements: Full-bleed warm bedroom lifestyle photo with soft rose-gold bokeh and a confident woman in fitted high-waisted jeans in the center-right
Two-line headline at the top left: white line over a rose-gold to fuchsia line
Left column of three benefits with thin-ringed white line-icon circles separated by thin dividers
The real bottle large in the lower-right foreground, identical to the attached photo
Wide rounded rose-gold delivery and payment band with a ringed icon at the bottom left
Small dark plum registration pill in the top-right corner
final_generation_exclusions: No explicit or revealing poses, no exaggerated body proportions, no hands pointing at body parts.
No second person and no before/after comparison.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
